newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Oct Oman crude trades at MPM minus nine cents/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Oct Oman crude trades at MPM minus nine cents/bbl.

text.p: A 500,000-barrel cargo of October Oman crude has traded at MPM minus 9 cents per barrel, a source at a company involved in the deal said on Friday.
The Oman cargo was sold by a U.S. major to a South Korean refinery on Thursday, the source said.

Oman cargos for October lifting were trading largely between flat to plus three cents per barrel over the MPM, or the official selling price of Oman crude, in the run up to the Asia-Pacific Petroleum Conference in Singapore this week.
October Oman last traded on September 4 between a European major and another South Korean refiner at MPM plus four cents.
But crude traders said several cargos of October Oman remained unsold, although most sellers could run them into their own refining systems.
